caveats: ⚑ skill2 has NO activation clause in the kit text — the interval:10s trigger is an INVENTED cadence, not kit-stated. Both skill2 blocks share it; if the real trigger is a full-charge/hit-count event the uptime of the 5s ATK window changes materially.

⚑ skill1's 'landing a Full Charge attack' / 'landing an attack on a target's core' triggers are proxied by shotFired (+ requiresCore for the core branch). On a charge SR every trigger pull is intended as a full charge, but shotFired does not verify charge level, and requiresCore is a boolean fight-level gate rather than a per-shot core roll — so the Pierce Damage buff is credited at 100% uptime wherever core exposure exists.
⚑ Base cadence (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6) is datamined and unverified; shot count per fight — and therefore the refresh cadence of every shotFired-keyed block — rides on it.

skill2's ally block is authored as targets {kind:'allies'} with no excludeSelf, so the caster receives BOTH the self atkPct 30.78% and the casterAtkPct 30.78% grant. That is the literal NIKKE reading of 'Affects all allies', but it is a stacking assumption worth confirming against a fight.

Burst damage carries no explicit noFb and no explicit crit: FB exemption is left to burst-cast timing (a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens), and crit eligibility is left to the engine's rider-crit path. Neither is measured for this unit.
pierceDamagePct is only live for Pierce-tagged hits; mari's own hits are Pierce-tagged solely inside skill2's 5s gainPierce windows (no whole-fight hasPierce flag is set).
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Mari (SR/Electric/Supporter/Burst II) is modeled as a pure support: skill1 grants the team Pierce Damage ▲40.99%/10s on core-landing shots (shotFired + requiresCore, allies); skill2 self-grants Pierce for 5s plus ATK ▲30.78%/5s and grants all allies a flat ATK add of 30.78% of mari's own ATK for 5s, both on an ⚑ invented interval trigger because the kit text gives skill2 no activation clause; her burst deals 639.36% of final ATK as burst-cast damage to the enemy and grants all allies Attack Damage ▲40.99% for 10s. The shield-damage line is deliberately unmodeled — the schema has no shield-damage StatKey and the scope-lock boss carries no shield. Top-level hasPierce is deliberately NOT set: her Pierce is a timed 5s window, expressed as a gainPierce effect.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #2: the kit text gives skill2 no activation clause at all, so both the trigger identity and its cadence are invented. A clause-free skill is conventionally an interval; 10s is a mid-range guess for a 5s-duration support window (≈50% uptime). The base-stat 'cd 20s' is the BURST cooldown for a Burst II unit and is not evidence for the skill-2 period. Uptime of the team ATK grant scales linearly with whatever this really is, so this is the single largest source of magnitude error in the file.
flags.recipe: Read the datamined skillCooldownsSec entry for mari's skill 2; if absent, count the ATK-buff icon appearances on her portrait in a scope-lock recording and take the median inter-appearance gap. Confirm the first-fire phase (t=0 vs t=CD) from the opening seconds of the same footage.

flags.estimate: {kind:'shotFired'} as a stand-in for 'landing a Full Charge attack'
flags.reasoning: There is no full-charge trigger kind. For a charge SR (chargeFrames 60, ammo 6) every trigger pull is intended to be a full charge, so shotFired is a 1:1 proxy under full-charge play, but it does not verify charge level and would over-fire if the sim ever models tapped shots. chargeCounter{count:1} was the alternative; it carries phase-cycling semantics this line does not have.
flags.recipe: Confirm the engine fires exactly one shotFired per charge release for an SR (DBG_UNIT=mari shot events) and that shot count over 180s matches chargeFrames+reload arithmetic; if tapped shots are ever modeled, re-key to chargeCounter.

flags.estimate: true (boolean gate — buff treated as ~100% uptime wherever core exposure exists)
flags.reasoning: The kit demands an actual core LANDING per activation, but requiresCore is a fight-level boolean, not a per-shot core roll. With a 10s duration on a repeating shot trigger the buff will be permanently up in the sim, whereas in-game it lapses whenever mari misses core for 10s. Direction of error: over-credit of the team Pierce Damage buff. Not correctable inside the current schema without a per-shot core-gated trigger.
flags.recipe: From footage, measure mari's core-hit fraction on the scope-lock boss; if 10s windows genuinely never lapse at that rate, the boolean gate is faithful and the flag closes. Otherwise record the gap in docs/engine-modeling-gaps.md rather than fudging the value.

flags.field: base cadence tuple (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6 / pullsPerSec)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire / reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and a nominal rate is not the effective 60fps-boundary rate. Every shotFired-keyed block in this file (the whole of skill1) refreshes on that cadence, so shot-count error propagates directly into buff uptime and into her own normal-attack damage.
flags.recipe: Count shots between two reloads off an ammo-counter read in a scope-lock recording (the ammo counter measures shots/sec directly); compare against 60/ceil(60/nominal) before trusting the datamined figure.

flags.estimate: {kind:'allies'} with no excludeSelf (mari receives both the self atkPct and the casterAtkPct grant)
flags.reasoning: 'Affects all allies' conventionally includes the caster in NIKKE, and the two lines are different stats (own-ATK % vs flat add off the caster's ATK), so they stack rather than overwrite. But the kit splits them into a self block and an allies block, which is also the shape a designer uses when the ally line is meant for OTHERS. If the split is exclusive, mari's own ATK is over-credited by ~30.78% of her static ATK.
flags.recipe: Solo-run mari and read her buff panel / DBG_BUFFS for two distinct ATK entries at cast time; a single entry means the ally block excludes self.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #6: per-kit noFb is measured-only and defaults OFF, and burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by TIMING in the engine (it lands before the FB window opens), so an explicit noFb would be an unmeasured assertion. crit is likewise left to the engine's rider-crit path rather than hard-set here, to avoid double-specifying a global behaviour.
flags.recipe: Read mari's burst popup colour in a recording (orange + icon = crit) and compare its magnitude against 639.36% × final ATK with and without the +50% FB major to confirm both defaults.
